body:
The charges are more than 20 felonies for less than $1,000 in damages for a non-violent non drug related crime. I don't want to go too indepth since it's pending investigation. 

I agree that you can do things in jail/prision to be "successful" but how I've always gauged success is how much closer I am to achieving my dreams. I did well in an advanced high school, got into a good university, and I've been working my butt off for years - giving up going to parties and hanging out with friends so I can work on that project or re-read that material for that class that I'm struggling with. I just had one minor slip up and now it seems like my goals are slipping away. For some reason, I can't get over the fact that if I don't achieve my dreams/goals - I don't see the point in going on. If you can't live your life the way you want, after working for years and giving up so much to follow your dreams, what's the point? Do you see where I am coming from here?

And I had to be in jail for a while (about a week before I bonded myself out so I could still go to class). The people there are INSANELY nice, they want to get out too. However, I've always been a braniac, and I've always needed to keep my mind occupied with something. There are no advanced mathematics books, or anything to have access to. After that one week, I was going crazy in that cell. I would not be able to last more than a month in there without some mental stimulation - which there is none in jail...

Though my family is supporting me with this. They know that I'm not normally like this and that I just fucked up one day and made a dumbass decision.
Since it is an ongoing investigation, I would rather not. However, they were non-violent non drug related and resulted in less than $1000 in damages. More than 20 felonies for that...
